fields.label: POS Mode
fields.description: Retail: quick counter sales. F&B: table management and kitchen order tickets (KOT). Switch with the toggle in the POS app (System Manager).

fields.label: Require an open shift to bill
fields.description: Cashiers must open a shift (with their opening cash) before they can bill.

fields.label: 24/7 operation
fields.description: Shifts may run across midnight and hand over without a day-end close. The business day still rolls over at the cut-off below.

fields.label: Continue billing on the previous day after midnight
fields.description: Sales rung up after midnight, until the time below, are posted to the previous business day (late-night trade / a bill opened before midnight).

fields.label: Checkout document
fields.description: POS Invoice: one submitted POS Invoice with the payments inside it. Draft Invoice + Receipt: checkout creates a Draft Sales Invoice; when payment is finalized it is submitted and a receipt (Payment Entry) is created against it with the chosen mode of payment.

fields.label: Send to kitchen automatically on save
fields.description: Saving an order creates the kitchen ticket (KOT) for what's new — no separate Send to kitchen step. The kitchen screen shows it at once and a kitchen printer prints it.

fields.label: Ask for a note when an item is added
fields.description: Shows suggested notes for the dish (well done, crunchy, no onions, ...) plus free text. Suggestions come from Claude when an Anthropic API key is configured, otherwise from a built-in list.
